comment: Furiah's Visuals: the battle axe's animation set (a one-handed axe held upright at the right, the head up). Swings run in vanilla's swing time; t is 0..1 of each clip. right: the fist in view space (offset in blocks, turns in degrees about the fist: pitch up, yaw left, roll counter-clockwise), or an exact place and direction ({pos, tip, edge}). Every clip here is original to this mod.

battle_axe_swing_1.comment: A diagonal chop from high on the right down to the lower left, the head leading.

battle_axe_swing_2.comment: A second chop, steeper, from above the head down across to the left.

battle_axe_swing_3.comment: A backhand hook: swung flat from the left back across to the right, the beard hooking.

battle_axe_quick_swing_1.comment: Rapid clicks: a short chop down to the left.

battle_axe_quick_swing_2.comment: Rapid clicks: a short backhand flick to the right.

battle_axe_crit.comment: A critical hit: raised high behind the shoulder and brought straight down in a heavy chop.

battle_axe_guard.comment: Blocking: the haft held upright in front, the head forward over the fist, its bit toward the blow.

battle_axe_dual_guard.comment: Blocking with an axe in each hand: the hafts crossed in an X, the heads up (the left hand's is this, mirrored).

battle_axe_draw.comment: The draw: up from the hip, flipped once end over end by the haft, and caught in the hold.
